program_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code = '''def transform(grid):
    """Recover the zeroed rectangular patch from its 180-degree counterpart."""
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in zero_cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in zero_cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in zero_cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in zero_cells)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][len(grid[0]) - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
